description: RFC 0016 K5 (R89) core-world smoke test: tools/quality/core_world_smoke.py boots every retail map of Portal (run/runtime) and Portal 2 (the Steam installation) headless with r_core_world 1 and r_core_world_strict at its default 1, and judges the core per map from r_core_world_stats. Maps come from the content; this file only excludes non-playable maps (each with its reason) and records known failures (each with its owner).

intermittent_failures.note: 2026-09-28 at b4773b13: one SIGSEGV loading sp_a1_intro1 after mp_coop_wall_intro (a co-op map) with the core on, right after 'Redownloading all lightmaps'; it did not recur in two more sweeps or three runs of the same pair, and the map loads with r_core_world 0. No core dump was retained; the process's engine.log and stdout.log are in the run's evidence. Untriaged: the crash may not be the core's.
